slides.title: Why outcome feedback needs a gate
slides.lead: A useful historical result must survive a new authority boundary.

columns.heading: What history can change
body: The current choice of investigation and the evidence needed before main Work.
How strongly the cell should rely on an earlier prediction at the current time.

columns.heading: What history cannot grant
body: Permission to spend, change a recipient or revive an expired action.
A substitute for current consent, native Root review or Host dispatch checks.

slides.title: Evidence classes remain separate
slides.takeaway: A saved reply, an executed native check and a pure comparison support different claims.

slides.title: Fixed point and round-half-even
slides.lead: Q = 1,000,000,000 keeps all admitted values on an explicit integer scale.
equations: R next = clamp(R + RHE(K × (Y − E) / Q), 0, Q)
E is the original prospective expectation. Y is 0 or Q.
Signed exact rational RHE rounds the increment before addition.
slides.takeaway: Missing or ineligible E or outcome gives NO_UPDATE. It never creates an artificial zero.
slides.notes: RHE means round-half-even. Native implementation uses integer arithmetic and explicit clamping. See numerical contract appendix for AVF and bounded history laws.

slides.title: Trust ages from the original observation
slides.lead: Trust decay and authority expiry answer separate questions.

columns.heading: Trust at time t
body: T(t) = RHE(R × 2^(−age / H))
The anchor is the earlier of the history observation and advice creation. Re-recording history does not make old advice young.

columns.heading: Consumability
body: valid_from is inclusive. valid_to is exclusive.
Independent TTL and maximum age checks can refuse advice. A usable zero trust value differs from expired, unusable advice.

slides.notes: Half-life H is bounded between 3600 and 604800 seconds. Exact half-life multiples use rational division. Other times use local Decimal precision 80. Age >= 64H yields zero. Additional review is recommended if and only if usable trust is below 600000000. Mandatory checks remain in every branch.

slides.title: CP-RANK changes the selected Work
slides.lead: Base scores stay frozen while admitted negative history changes advice.
slides.takeaway: The selected observability investigation actually executes before main Work.
slides.notes: Controlled native predictions. Same common mandatory/check profile in both branches. P after three negatives is -176025391. Later positive prediction recovers P while retaining earlier negative history. This is an executed controlled contrast, not an observed model accuracy estimate.

slides.title: CP-TIME adds an evidence obligation
slides.lead: The same positive history has less trust after one half-life.
sideBody: Aged advice produces NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE and zero main Work.
An observability receipt satisfies the obligation. Ordinary reconsideration then accepts.
slides.takeaway: Runtime invocations use actual ages d and d + H. The chart shows reference values, not retimed receipts.
slides.notes: Positive snapshot R_fp=665039062, H=50330 seconds, P_fp=176025391. Actual contrast holds matching diagnostic A and history constant and changes only evaluation time. Each invocation uses a separately bounded current context and fresh pure-only Host/Root. No expired Sentinel session is extended.

slides.title: Four original calls to one model
slides.lead: Gemini 2.5 Flash supplied the four proposals. No valid reply was retried.
slides.takeaway: G36R reuses these saved replies. Captured repair makes zero new provider calls.
slides.notes: Provider elapsed values are receipt measurements rounded to milliseconds. Monetary cost is UNKNOWN. Four cases from one model do not support statistical generalization or model ranking. The original live attempt was interrupted and later completed through captured phases.

slides.title: Why G36R needed a chronology repair

columns.heading: Original G36 sequence
body: ADV-1 consumed the objective early. Later ADV-2 and CONTINUE could not create a second effect.
The completed captured chain ended SAFE_NO_DEAL at CONTINUE. The original live attempt had been interrupted.

columns.heading: Corrected G36R sequence
body: ADV-1 and ADV-2 stop after ordinary bound preparation. The objective remains available.
ADV-3 exercises expiry. Current history then drives fresh provenance Work and one lawful continuation.

slides.takeaway: G36R is a captured engineering repair. It preserves original request and reply origins.
slides.notes: Do not describe this as an uninterrupted original-live completion, original preregistered protocol, additional model samples, or weight training.

slides.title: Root authority stays local
slides.takeaway: Past acceptance never restores an expired permission. A replayed receipt never executes an action.
slides.notes: These are the demonstrated authority boundaries. The table does not claim universal security or production certification.

slides.title: Cryptographic identity and its limits

columns.heading: What the package verifies
body: SHA-256 pins exact source and manifest bytes. Git object IDs identify commit, parent and tree.
History lineage hashes and independent expected anchors support relation checks where the schema supplies them.

columns.heading: What this does not prove
body: A checksum is not a signature and does not authenticate a signer by itself.
Matching bytes do not establish physical truth, current permission or the correctness of every claim inside those bytes.

slides.notes: Use actual manifests, source pins, Git object identities and hashed history lineage. Do not imply a PKI, signing service or independent signer where none is present.

slides.title: Declared limits
body: Four calls to one model do not establish general adversarial robustness, model ranking or calibrated population accuracy.
Captured repair establishes the corrected native chronology. It does not add independent live model samples or train model weights.
All effects here are synthetic or mock. No real payment, shipment or physical-world outcome follows from these records.
Two failed, superseded historical helper bodies remain unavailable. The retained receipts and this gap are disclosed.
slides.notes: No production/security certification. Full native graph replay remains unsupported. G38 selected fixtures may construct controlled G3 but do not request providers or perform real effects. See historical helper appendix for precise scope.

slides.title: Appendix: bounded update and time laws
rows: At most 256 audit rows and 64 effective occurrences
Exact duplicates count once. Conflicts fail closed.
3 events means WARM counting state. Review if T < 0.6Q.
H = 3,600–604,800 s. Independent TTL and max age.
slides.takeaway: WARM is a counting state. It does not turn sparse history into statistical certainty.
slides.notes: P_next = clamp(P + RHE(eta*(Signal-P)/Q),-Q,Q). Delta=RHE(beta*P/Q). Adjusted=clamp(Base+Delta,0,Q). Root micros=RHE(Adjusted*1000000/Q). Decay anchor=min(history_observation_anchor,advice_created_at). Exact half-life multiples use exact rational division. Nonmultiples use Decimal precision 80. age>=64H gives zero. valid_from inclusive, valid_to exclusive. Expiry independently occurs at advice_created_at+TTL and age>=604800. Usable zero and expired not consumable are distinct.
